CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `configuracao_territorio` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `municipioId` int,
  `codigoIbge` varchar(7),
  `nomeMunicipio` varchar(255),
  `limiteFamiliasPorAcs` int DEFAULT 150,
  `limiteCidadaosPorAcs` int DEFAULT 750,
  `limiteAreaKm2PorAcs` decimal(10,4),
  `latCentro` decimal(10,8),
  `lngCentro` decimal(11,8),
  `zoomInicial` int DEFAULT 13,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `configuracao_territorio_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `territorios` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `nome` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `codigo` varchar(20),
  `municipioId` int,
  `codigoIbge` varchar(7),
  `geojsonPoligono` text,
  `cor` varchar(7) DEFAULT '#3B82F6',
  `ativo` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `territorios_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `areas` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `nome` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `codigo` varchar(20),
  `territorioId` int,
  `cnes` varchar(7),
  `nomeUbs` varchar(255),
  `latUbs` decimal(10,8),
  `lngUbs` decimal(11,8),
  `geojsonPoligono` text,
  `cor` varchar(7) DEFAULT '#10B981',
  `totalMicroareas` int DEFAULT 0,
  `totalFamilias` int DEFAULT 0,
  `totalCidadaos` int DEFAULT 0,
  `ativo` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `areas_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `acs_perfil` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `cns` varchar(15),
  `cpf` varchar(14),
  `nome` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `cnes` varchar(7),
  `ine` varchar(10),
  `areaId` int,
  `latDomicilio` decimal(10,8),
  `lngDomicilio` decimal(11,8),
  `capacidadeMaxFamilias` int DEFAULT 150,
  `capacidadeMaxCidadaos` int DEFAULT 750,
  `ativo` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `acs_perfil_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
